name: Canada
description: Follow Canada, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
changes.summary: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

changes.title: Canada faces one of its most intense fire seasons
changes.summary: With nearly 1,000 active fires and an area as large as Belgium already burned, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney says his country is facing one of the "most intense" wildfire seasons in its history.

changes.title: Researchers challenge evidence behind high-profile parental alienation study
changes.summary: Researchers from Manchester and Canada have shown that the claim by the authors of a study published earlier this year that most of its participants had experienced parental alienating behaviors during childhood is seriously misleading. changes.title: Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ Brings in $124.5 Million at the Box Office on Opening Weekend
changes.summary: Christopher Nolan’s nearly three-hour epic was No. 1 over the weekend, with about $124.5 million in ticket sales in the United States and Canada.

changes.title: Are workplaces safer? Harassment and violence persist, survey finds
changes.summary: A follow-up national survey developed by Western researchers shows workplace harassment and violence continue to be widespread in Canada, with some signs of improvement. The second national survey on harassment and violence at work in Canada was conducted by Western's Center for Research and Education on Violence Again.

changes.title: Wildfire smoke fouls air across Northeast
changes.summary: Smoke from hundreds of wildfires burning across Canada and Minnesota is creating air quality issues in the Northeast. There are also severe weather threats to the Midwest, as well as the risk of flash flooding in some areas. Meteorologist Andrew Kozak has the forecast.

changes.title: Air quality improving in Northeast, while wildfire smoke hangs over Midwest
changes.summary: Wildfire smoke and unhealthy air persist and shift direction, as Trump demands explanation from Canada. (Image credit: Finn Gomez/Getty Images).

changes.title: What the US and Canada Can Expect from the Wildfire Smoke This Weekend
changes.summary: The smoke isn’t going away, but where it affects air quality will shift over the next few days.

changes.title: Maps show wildfire smoke forecast, air quality alerts in swath of U.S.
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is engulfing large swaths of the Midwest and the U.S. East Coast this week.

changes.title: Wildfire smoke from Canada and Minnesota pushes farther into the U.S. and engulfs D.C. in haze
changes.summary: Warnings of dangerous conditions were expected to remain in effect through Saturday across a wide swath of the U.S., though there's potential for temporary improvement with storms forecast in some affected areas during the weekend.
